title: Why ML-based cough models do not generalize: a systematic cross-dataset evaluation for tuberculosis screening
abstract: arXiv:2608.25846v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cough acoustics are promising for non-invasive tuberculosis (TB) screening, yet whether machine learning (ML) models capture disease-related acoustics or artifacts of data collection remains unresolved. We evaluated the cross-dataset generalizability of classical ML and deep learning (DL) cough-based TB classifiers across three independent datasets. Despite moderate within-dataset performance (ROC-AUC up to $0.755 \pm 0.056$), both pipelines fail to generalize, with external performance frequently below 0.6, indicating a possible limitation of the data. We further observed audio representations are organized by recording device and dataset rather than TB status, predicted TB probability tracks country-level prevalence in CODA, and device mismatch degrades transfer while device-diverse training improves it. Additionally, a clinical-variable baseline generalizes more consistently (ROC-AUC $0.655 - 0.711$), indicating acquisition-specific

translated_title: 为什么基于机器学习的咳嗽模型无法泛化：针对结核病筛查的系统性跨数据集评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25846v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：咳嗽声学特征对于非侵入性结核病（TB）筛查具有潜力，但机器学习（ML）模型捕捉的是疾病相关声学特征还是数据采集伪影，这一问题仍未解决。我们在三个独立数据集上评估了经典机器学习和深度学习（DL）咳嗽基结核病分类器的跨数据集泛化能力。尽管数据集内性能中等（ROC-AUC最高达$0.755 \pm 0.056$），但两种流程均无法泛化，外部性能经常低于0.6，表明可能存在数据局限性。我们进一步观察到，音频表征按录音设备和数据集组织，而非按结核病状态组织；预测的结核病概率在CODA中追踪国家层面的患病率；设备不匹配会降低迁移性能，而设备多样化的训练则能改善迁移。此外，临床变量基线模型泛化更一致（ROC-AUC $0.655 - 0.711$），表明采集特异性因素占主导。
tldr: 本研究通过系统跨数据集评估发现，基于咳嗽的机器学习结核病分类器无法泛化，其性能受录音设备和数据集特异性影响，而非疾病本身，提示需谨慎对待此类模型的实际应用。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates cough-based ML classifiers across datasets, revealing they fail to generalize due to acquisition-specific factors like recording devices and dataset artifacts, rather than disease-related acoustics.
